nativeObservations.by: dph-4 builder (harness, setup, registration; a harness implementer, not the fixture author)
nativeObservations.commit: DPH-4 commit a14eac73 (5bca62cb after the rebase onto 50a40557)
nativeObservations.what: Before this record was frozen, the harness's cargo tests ran every variant of all nine cases of this fixture's materials through Native (setup with product writers, the real D-final, packer and renderer) on every run of `cargo test ... nir1_final_request_eval`, and an ignored development dump wrote receipts without the freeze gate. The DPH-4 builder scored the dump with the scorer and reported per-case verdicts to the integrator; a prototype run showed every positive failing with other-case-material (DR-DPH-57), which led to the project_create change in the harness, not to a change of the fixture.
nativeObservations.materialsObserved: all nine cases (P-01, P-02, P-04, P-05, P-06, P-07, P-08, P-10, P-11), every variant
nativeObservations.disposition: Recorded here and in dp-h-decisions.md (DR-DPH-69..72). The harness no longer runs this fixture without the freeze gate (the mechanics tests use a synthetic fixture). Under the draft's rule on observed materials this fixture version must not be frozen as is: the contract refuses a frozen record with nativeOutputObservedBeforeFreeze true. Its expectations are also stale after X1-3 (#674). The integrator replaces the materials (new logical IDs and texts) and the expectations through a separate fixture author, with a new independent review, before freezing.

note: Pending the independent expectation review, and not freezable as it stands: Native observed this fixture's materials before the freeze (see nativeObservations). A replacement fixture (new materials, author separate from the harness implementers) with a new review record is required; its record sets nativeOutputObservedBeforeFreeze false and no observations before the integrator rewrites it with status frozen, reviewVerdict approve, the review record's new sha256 and a new frozenAt, and commits it before any Native run of the new fixture's material.

contextBudget.formula: contextBudgetTokens = contextWindowTokens - (fixedSystemTokens + userTokens + envelopeTokens + outputTokens + safetyMarginTokens + separatorReserveTokens); selectedTokens = estimateTokens(rawText) + sum(estimateTemplateTokens(entry.text)) with each placeholder counted as maxLength ASCII characters (36 for ids, 128 for tokens); marginTokens = contextBudgetTokens - selectedTokens. Estimator: nir1-context-estimator-v1 (ceil((utf16Length + 2 * cjkCount) / 3)) applied by hand to the template files and the fixture strings; no Native packer, renderer or D-final was run.

terms.source: route values equal the existing D-final test route (16384 / 1024); they are fixture values, not product limits

fixtureAuthor.role: writes the fixture; no harness, baseline, capture or scorer code

expectationReviewer.role: independent, read-only, has not seen Native output
